name: Plasma Mainline / Generic item entry earns no steam-transfer ability
printed_text:
This enters the arena with 5 steam counters. When it has none, destroy it.

Whenever a Mechanologist item with cost 2 or less enters the arena under your control, you may move a steam counter from this to that item.

name: Hyper Driver / ordinary attack is not boosting
printed_text:
When this has no steam counters, destroy it.

Once per turn, when you **boost** a card, remove a steam counter from this and gain {r}.
